focus: Adaptive Hierarchical Depth Selection via Capability Composition
question: Will a prospectively deployed adaptive depth‑selection policy, derived offline by choosing the depth that minimizes observed error for each horizon, achieve higher expected utility than any single fixed depth policy?
hypothesis: When evaluated on fresh planning tasks, the adaptive policy will produce a statistically higher expected utility (i.e., lower average planning error) than the best static depth policy identified from the same observational data, yielding a positive G_A.
next_action: Schedule and execute the comparative experiment on Gemini, collect the error metrics, and update the policy repository based on the results.
